text:
jordan: Quick question — I have a tiny docs-only PR that updates the changelog version bump (v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4). Cutoff is 16:00 PT today, right? Can we get exception?

devon (release-czar): Cutoff is 16:00 PT yes. Docs-only usually ok if no schema/behavior changes. Drop the PR and a short risk note here.

jordan: PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/6412
Risk: docs-only, changelog entry, no code changes. CI passed locally but github actions still running. Will not touch runtime code.

ops-bot: Reminder: release code-freeze cron just ran; any merge after 16:00 will require a signed late-exception and a patch approval from release-czar + 2 approvers. :warning:

devon (release-czar): Reviewing... if CI green and changelog only, we'll allow a fast-track. @sylvia can you sanity-check the changelog blurb?

sylvia: taking a look. quick nit: please change "perf improvements" to "ops perf" — tiny phrasing fix. otherwise ok. :+1:

priya: I can push the phrasing fix directly to the PR branch if you want me to, @jordan. Will run a quick `make docs` locally.

jordan: please do, thanks @priya. I'll re-run the smoke job after.

jordan: pushed fix and re-ran smoke: all good. CI (github actions) still shows queued but no failures yet.

devon (release-czar): OK — since it's docs-only and sylvia approved, I clear this as a late merge exception. Jenkins and GA must be green before I merge. Note: leave a changelog author line. I'll sign exception once CI is green.

release-bot: CI status: github/actions/validators — queued

ops-bot: Please remember to add the post-merge tag so release tooling picks this up: `changelog:manual` in PR body.

jordan: added `changelog:manual` to PR body. Thanks all. I'll ping again when GA is green.

release-bot: CI status update: github/actions/validators — success

devon (release-czar): CI green, merging now. Added signed late-exception: `exception/signed-by:devon` — merging to main. :rocket:

jordan: thanks everyone! Saved the release from a no-changelog gap. :relieved:
